en: Small progress is still progress

ko: 시작이 가장 어려운 걸음이에요. 그래도 할 수 있어요.
en: Starting is the most difficult step - but you can do it

ko: 단거리 달리기가 아니라 마라톤이에요. 한 번에 한 걸음씩 가요.
en: It is not a sprint, it is a marathon. One step at a time

ko: 작은 한 걸음마다 나는 나아가고 있어요.
en: I make progress with every small step.

ko: 앞으로 내딛는 걸음마다 작은 승리로 쳐 줘요.
en: I celebrate each step forward as a victory.
I embrace progress over perfection on my journey to success.

ko: 크든 작든 해낸 일을 스스로 축하해요.
en: I celebrate my growth and successes, big and small.

ko: 아무리 작아도 내가 해낸 진전을 인정해요.
en: I honor my progress, no matter how small.
I create momentum through consistent action.

ko: 오늘도 나타나서 할 수 있는 만큼 해요.
en: I show up and give my best effort.

ko: 목표를 향해 꾸준히 한 걸음씩 가요.
en: I take consistent steps toward my goals.
I admire you for taking this on

ko: 차근차근 하다 보면 길을 찾게 될 거예요.
en: You'll find a way
Struggling is part of learning
Mistakes don't make you less capable
It's not a mistake, it's a learning opportunity

ko: 실패는 제대로 하는 법을 배우는 또 다른 길이에요.
en: Failure is just another way to learn how to do something right
The past does not equal the future
My past does not define my present.

ko: 예전 작업에서 흠이 보인다면, 그만큼 자랐다는 뜻이에요.
en: Don't worry if you find flaws in your past creations, it's because you've evolved
You know more than you knew yesterday
We are all works in progress
I grow through what I go through.

ko: 모든 경험이 나를 조금씩 나아지게 해요.
en: Every experience helps me evolve and improve.

ko: 나는 몇 번이고 다시 일어설 수 있어요.
en: I am capable of rising again and again.
I have the strength to keep moving forward.
I persist with determination and hope.
I am braver than my fears.

ko: 나에게 맞는 선택을 해도 된다고 스스로 허락해요.
en: I give myself permission to do what is right for me
I give myself permission to feel and to heal.
I allow myself to heal at my own pace.
I honor my emotions without judgment.

ko: 내 감정은 타당하고, 다정하게 대할 가치가 있어요.
en: My emotions are valid and worthy of compassion.
I am gentle with myself as I heal.
I treat my heart with kindness and patience.
I trust the natural rhythm of my healing.
I embrace myself with compassion and gentle understanding.
I treat myself with the same kindness I offer the world.

ko: 남에게 주는 사랑을 나도 받을 자격이 있어요.
en: I deserve the same love I freely give to others.

ko: 나는 내 때에 피어나요. 그거면 충분해요.
en: I bloom in my own time, and that is enough.

ko: 자라는 동안 나 자신에게 인내심을 가져요.
en: I am patient with myself as I grow.
I celebrate the person I am becoming.
I release overwhelm and embrace mental peace.
I return to my breath and center myself.

ko: 숨을 들이쉬며 평온을, 내쉬며 긴장을 보내요.
en: I breathe in peace and exhale tension.

ko: 내가 어쩔 수 없는 일은 내려놓고 마음을 편히 가져요.
en: I let go of what I cannot control and embrace peace.
I am at peace with where I am right now.
I approach each task with calm concentration.
I direct my attention to what truly matters.
I am present and grateful for this moment.
I experience life one moment at a time.
I notice and celebrate small joys.

ko: 소박하지만 의미 있는 순간들을 소중히 여겨요.
en: I appreciate the simple and meaningful moments.

ko: 무슨 일이 와도 하나씩 해 나갈 수 있다고 나를 믿어요.
en: I trust myself to handle whatever comes my way.
I honor my needs and boundaries in relationships.
I choose understanding over conflict.
